Construct an Explicit SLURM Resource Specification

Source: R/resources.R
resource_spec.Rd

Creates a validated slurmpilot_resources object directly from user-chosen chunk size, memory, walltime, and scheduler flags (without requiring a micro-pilot run).

Usage

resource_spec(
  n_tasks,
  chunk_size = 1L,
  mem_mb = 1024,
  time_minutes = 15,
  cpus_per_task = 1L,
  partition = NULL,
  account = NULL,
  qos = NULL,
  max_concurrent = NULL,
  strategy = c("contiguous", "round_robin", "lpt"),
  task_weights = NULL
)

Arguments

n_tasks

Positive integer total number of tasks.

chunk_size

Positive integer number of tasks grouped into each SLURM array chunk. Default 1L.

mem_mb

Numeric memory limit per array task in MB. Default 1024.

time_minutes

Numeric walltime limit per array task in minutes. Default 15.

cpus_per_task

Positive integer CPU cores per array task. Default 1L.

partition

Optional SLURM --partition.

account

Optional SLURM --account.

qos

Optional SLURM --qos.

max_concurrent

Optional positive integer array concurrency cap.

strategy

Chunk assignment strategy: "contiguous" (default), "round_robin", or "lpt".

task_weights

Optional positive numeric vector of length n_tasks required when strategy = "lpt".

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_resources".

See also

estimate_resources(), plan_chunks(), as_slurm_flags()

Examples

spec <- resource_spec(n_tasks = 100, chunk_size = 10, mem_mb = 2048, time_minutes = 30)
as_slurm_flags(spec)
#> [1] "--array=1-10"      "--cpus-per-task=1" "--mem=2G"         
#> [4] "--time=00:30:00"
